audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Vayne levels 2 and 3 outright and called level 1 and level 6 'Skill', while every whys[] string on those rows says Lucian out-ranges and out-bursts her.
audit.why: The mirror audit (lucian__vayne) settled Level 1, Level 2, Level 3 and Level 6 to Lucian, with Levels 4-5 staying Skill and both item rows staying Vayne. The kit supports it: Lightslinger makes every ability into a double-shot, Piercing Light pierces on a 9s cooldown, Ardent Blaze marks from 900, and The Culling reaches 1400 — all outside Vayne's 550 Condemn range before items.
audit.corrected: phases[0]/win[0], phases[1]/win[1], phases[2]/win[2] and phases[4]/win[4] set to Lucian as matched pairs, proposed as one atomic group. Levels 4-5 left at Skill and both item rows left at Vayne, per the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and mid described The Culling only as 'a huge poke-and-execute wave' with no range and no cooldown, and 'his E-dash aggression' was never given a number.
audit.why: The Culling is 1400 range on 110s at rank 1 — the range is why it shoves you off CS with no counterplay, and the cooldown is why surviving it once buys most of a wave cycle. Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1, shortened by his Lightslinger attacks, so the gap between dashes is the only step-up window Vayne gets pre-item.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[1], mid, early, whys[3], whys[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned that Ardent Blaze reveals, which is the one interaction that beats Vayne's level-6 plan.
audit.why: Riot's text for Ardent Blaze: it marks and briefly reveals enemies hit. Final Hour's whole value here is invisibility during Tumble, and a 900-range W on a 14s cooldown strips it. Reusing the mirror's finding rather than re-deriving it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d now names the reveal and the Final Hour Tumble it answers; breakdown.cooldowns lists Ardent Blaze's 14s and 900 range.
